name: policy
description: Top-level container for an ordered set of rules, used to examine and modify an XDS document.
:LABEL: Element

name: rule
description: A fundamental building block specifying a set of conditions and actions.
:LABEL: Element

name: conditions
description: Defines criteria (CNF or DNF) that must be met for actions to be performed.
:LABEL: Element

name: actions
description: The operations (<do-*>) performed when conditions are met.
:LABEL: Element

name: do-add-association
description: Add an association to the current object.
:LABEL: Element

name: do-add-dest-attr-value
description: Add a value to a destination attribute.
:LABEL: Element

name: do-add-src-attr-value
description: Add a value to a source attribute.
:LABEL: Element

name: do-break
description: Break out of the current loop or action.
:LABEL: Element

name: do-for-each
description: For-each loop over a node set.
:LABEL: Element

name: Argument_Elements
description: Elements defining dynamic input data for Actions.
:LABEL: Element

name: arg-actions
description: Specifies actions associated with the enclosing action (e.g., do-if, do-while). Contains <do-*> elements.
:LABEL: Element

name: arg-conditions
description: Specifies conditions associated with the enclosing action (e.g., do-if, do-while). Contains <and> or <or> elements.
:LABEL: Element

name: arg-dn
description: DN argument. Concatenates enclosed tokens to form a DN value.
:LABEL: Element

name: arg-node-set
description: Node set argument. Specifies an XPATH 1.0 node-set.
:LABEL: Element

name: arg-query-condition
description: Query condition argument. Specifies a logical conditional search expression.
:LABEL: Element

name: arg-string
description: String argument. Concatenates enclosed tokens to form a string value.
:LABEL: Element

name: arg-value
description: Value argument. Specifies an attribute value.
:LABEL: Element

name: Token_Elements
description: Dynamic values expanded at run-time (45+ types listed).
:LABEL: Element

name: token-added-entitlement
description: Granted entitlement value(s) in the current operation.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-association
description: Association value from the current operation.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-attr
description: Attribute value(s) in the current operation or source datastore (union of op-attr and src-attr).
:LABEL: Element

name: token-base64-decode
description: Decode base64 data into a string.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-base64-encode
description: Encode a string into base64 data.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-class-name
description: Object class name from the current operation.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-convert-time
description: Convert a date/time from one format to another.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-dest-attr
description: Attribute value(s) of current object in the destination datastore.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-dest-dn
description: Value derived from the destination DN.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-dest-name
description: Unqualified RDN derived from destination DN.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-entitlement
description: Value(s) of a granted entitlement of the current object.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-escape-for-dest-dn
description: Convert a string for use in a destination DN.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-escape-for-src-dn
description: Convert a string for use in a source DN.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-join
description: Join a node-set into a string.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-lower-case
description: Convert a string to lower case.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-map
description: Map a string through a mapping table.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-map-source-col
description: Used in token-map to have multiple source columns.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-op-attr
description: Value(s) of an attribute only in the current operation.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-password
description: Value of the password in current operation.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-query
description: Query the source or destination datastore.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-removed-attr
description: Value(s) of an attribute removed in the current operation.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-removed-entitlement
description: Value(s) of an entitlement revoked in the current operation.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-replace-all
description: Replace all instances of a substring within a string.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-replace-first
description: Replace a single instance of a substring within a string.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-resolve
description: Resolve a DN to an association key or vice versa.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-split
description: Split a string into a node-set.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-src-attr
description: Value(s) of an attribute only in the source datastore.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-src-dn
description: Value derived from the source DN.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-src-name
description: Unqualified RDN derived from source DN.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-unmatched-src-dn
description: A DN relative to the one matched by if-src-dn.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-upper-case
description: Convert a string to upper case.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-xml-parse
description: Parse XML. Returns a document node in a node-set.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-xml-serialize
description: Serialize a node-set result as XML.
:LABEL: Element

name: token-xpath
description: Result of evaluating an XPATH 1.0 expression.
:LABEL: Element
